answer: A practical sybil defense is to make influence follow demonstrated judgment: every claim an identity makes must be countersigned by peers who only gained weight through work that stood the test of review, like a signal that only carries if the dawn watch actually verified it by hand. Each attestation holds up a mirror to the claimant's history, so a bot farm reflects a thousand blank faces that cancel out, while one long-lived honest node reflects a record nobody can clone. Copying work yields nothing because the mirror compares, not trusts.
